_doc: Voxel gear. `parts` maps a recipe's parts to gear, first rule that matches (part: an id or an id's prefix; tag: a tag the part has in parts.json; slot: its slot). A held item has a hand (right, left) and a hold (in holds); its shapes are in the hold's frame: [point, along, out, side] from the hand, along the held direction, out of the front, to the right. Worn gear has fits: shapes per body (bodies/<id>.json), * for any other, in the body's own frame; `helm` and `fit` are the body's helmet and armour spots. flags: what the gear tells body shapes (if / unless). foot: a foot soldier's tall shield, which reaches into a mount: no kit gives it to a rider (rider_check).
